subject: english
question: **Select the wrongly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **Paralel.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **The correct spelling and meaning of the selected option are: 

 
 
• **Parallel:** similar and happening at the same time.
 
 
 
• Thus, the wrongly spelt word is **Paralel**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Premium: **an extra payment.
 
• **Penalty: **a punishment for breaking a law, rule or contract.
 
• **Passage: **a long, narrow way with walls on either side that connects one place with another.
